about: Gina D. Wodarski is the founding partner of her firm, GDW Law, in Andover, Massachusetts, where she applies more than 25 years of legal and business acumen to serve clients ranging from emerging start-ups to Fortune 100 companies. She has built a reputation as trusted national counsel, guiding organizations through a broad spectrum of corporate, business and employment-related challenges.

In her role as general counsel, Ms. Wodarski has advised boards of directors and executive teams on policy development and administration and regulatory compliance. She routinely drafts business policies, employee handbooks, executive agreements, commercial/business contracts and various plans, ensuring that each document aligns with a client’s operational goals.

Known for her strategic thinking, leadership skills and clear communication, Ms. Wodarski assesses complex legal matters swiftly and delivers solutions designed to advance her clients’ objectives. She is admitted to practice in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts and in several other jurisdictions throughout the U.S. When internal investigations or audits arise, she leads the inquiry with discretion and rigor, and she designs and presents training sessions to help companies strengthen their practices and reduce future risk.

Ms. Wodarski has represented clients in state and federal courts, before administrative agencies and in arbitration proceedings nationwide. Whether defending or prosecuting wrongful termination claims, litigating contract disputes or navigating complex multijurisdictional employment matters, she approaches every case with thorough preparation and tenacious advocacy. Her courtroom successes have reinforced her clients’ confidence in her ability to secure favorable outcomes under pressure.

A graduate of Boston College Law School, Ms. Wodarski earned her Juris Doctor after completing her Bachelor of Science magna cum laude in political science at Boston College. Early in her career, she clerked for the Honorable Judge Joseph A. Rodriguez in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey and later served as of counsel at prominent law firms, honing her skills in high-stakes litigation and corporate counseling. She is frequently invited to share her insights at industry conferences and has authored numerous articles on legal and business topics.
